text: The Esports World Cup and the Esports World Cup Foundation were announced by Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman as part of Saudi Arabia's National Gaming and Esports Strategy and Vision 2030, aiming to add more than SAR 50 billion to GDP and create 39,000 jobs by 2030.

source.name: Esports World Cup - HRH Crown Prince announces Esports World Cup (official)
source.note: The foundation is a state project by the crown prince's own announcement; page dated Jul 31, 2023 in the header, announcement text dated Riyadh, October 23, 2023.
